translation.name: Fúka Moodaanaki Kira Ufa Afaqínaasa Ufa

book.name: UQAFIQOO UFAFA
book.title: UQAFIQOO UFAFA Naaru kambiqaaninnainaina Yoohaneena uqafiqoo ufafa.

content: Maa maqafa taikainna aukuana dinni ani qaara marasee qangiroo aupurarana maree anifara.

Qinee innaarunai mariafana moo innaarunai koorooira ainaina naaquqara ainaina kambiqoo qafaqiafana maaqimasee kambiqanau. Qisauku dinni taikasee dinni ani qaara marasee qangiroo namu nári nisaukuki Anutuna taikaranaki aupurarana uqirausa aniqau. Mi aupurarana maqasaaqaraasa Anutuna ufa sia irimariasa nimisaifanoo Anutuna aranaqarafa taikaannoo.

Qinee mina qafamasee quandaki ooruku nammariara foora tanuka minasaa maridanoora foora idauru namufaqa marufaqa qafaqiafana. Miqoo ooruku nammari afaisaa faiqí anaasee moomoo Anutuna ufa irimarusa usimariqau. Misa kaasau aandau akarara qaoo qimarusa misa kaasau aandau faqa mina amana auqirana faqa rakiara foora mina uriqararausa mariqau. Anutufa misa piripunna nimufaqa misa
Anutuna ainainira faiqi Mooseena faqa sipsipa aanaaqi kuqufa faqa miqanda idi ree mariqau. Maaqi qimasee idi raqau.

content.text: Anee aiqamausa rakisi marianna oosanafa faqa anee imarianna oosana faqa idaaqirafa firaafa maridanoo.
Anee niniunafa andeeqarafa kuqaa marunafa marianafa.
Oo Karaambaiqa yafasiqa fee sia aniara rufiaidanoo.
Yafasiqa fee ani uriqararana sia koorooiannoo,
Ani andeeqara ainainirafa aiqamausa qafamasee minara aiqama maqannaa aniree ani oorisaa aniree ani amooqifaranoo.

content: Misa mi idina ramasoofaqa qinee Yoohaneesa qafaafananoo Anutuna amaana maqa innaarunai atuasoofaqa qafaafananoo minaki ooqai Mooseefa Anutuna uiqaana maqa usakaqoofa mina aundurai marufaqa qinee qafaqiafana.

Dinni taikasee dinni ani qaara marasee qangiroouqa Anutufa faiqí anaasee nimianinna aupurarana uqirausa faasai nindafaafanausa misa Anutuna naaquqara amaana maqakiqari raudaqau. Misa qamunna anukarafa eekara arirafa marinau. Misa koora auqira raitanda naamma ameemaanai rumbarausa animariqau.

Ani marufanoo Anutuna aaqa aandau qaara faqa qaara faqa marunakiqari moo fannoo koora auqimaru qafeesa dinni taikasee dinni ani qaaraqanda marasee qafeesa naaru naaru marira Anutuna aanooqirafa qumbiqara qafeeuqa aiqama qangiroouqa nisaukuki moodaa moodaa quqasanau.

Quqasoofanoo innaarunai amaana maqa idamuna qumbiqanau. Anutuna afeeka faqa Anutuna areenarana faqa minasaaqari idamuna fannoo mi amaana maqanaki qumbiqanau, sia keeqarana amana marinau. Nisauku dinni taikasee dinni ani qaara marasee qangiroo misa aupurarana taikasoofanoo miqoo kai amana keeqaaqaainau.
